bias_targets.methodology: As a position paper, it does not empirically measure bias, but proposes evaluating it by constructing fairness-oriented benchmarks covering diverse accents to audit accent stereotyping and ensure fair assessment across underrepresented groups.

The paper does not conduct empirical measurements, but advocates for the development of evaluation datasets covering diverse genders to audit gender stereotyping and assess fair performance in TTS systems.

The paper suggests evaluating linguistic and minority speech bias by creating benchmarks that include diverse languages to enable fair assessment of performance across different demographic and linguistic groups.
